Original binaries and data from FreeShip Plus 3.5, preserved unchanged.
Authors and institutions retain their copyrights. These executables are not
claimed to be GPL source code or authored by the FreeShip 26 project.

Upstream author program list: https://hydro.ucoz.net/programsE.html
Original downloads: https://hydro.ucoz.net/downloads.html
Lazarus maintainer confirms the EXEs are packaged:
https://github.com/markmal/freeship-plus-in-lazarus/issues/102#issuecomment-2062874995
The maintainer describes them as proprietary:
https://github.com/markmal/freeship-plus-in-lazarus/issues/96#issuecomment-1368580141

use only. Copyright (c) 1987-1994 Dudchenko O.M., 1992-2009 Timoshenko V.F.
The website lists v1.04 while some help headings say v1.03; no removal of that

FreeShip 26 includes these unmodified modules following the upstream bundle
and the project owner's 2026-11-17 request. No separate unrestricted

provenance and known restrictions; it does not grant additional rights.
